record: simulated, not measured; pre-layout; target tier (5 V -> 1.8 V, 50 -> 450 -> 50 mA); rows R12, R13(b), R13(c)

method.analysis: .tran 2.5n 760u, waveforms saved from 480u; max step 2.5 ns = T/200 at 2 MHz
method.startup: Vin ramps 0 -> Vin over 10 us, rails/bias over 5 us, EN at 20 us (soft start ~200 us), load 0 -> 50 mA at 260 us

load_step.cycles_after_each_step: ~160 at 2 MHz (spec 0.4 needs >= 100 or 20 in-band cycles, whichever is longer)

method.steady_state: spec 0.4 settled test (two consecutive 20-cycle windows, < 0.1 % mean Vout, < 1 % peak I(L)) on the cycles just before each edge; a step that fails it reports no value (units[].up / .back .settled)
method.measurement: deviation = larger of under/overshoot about the Vout the run settles to after the step (mean of the last 20 whole cycles of the hold), on Vout after the 20 MHz first-order low-pass (as R11); recovery = last exit from +-18 mV, from the start of the load edge
method.clock: switched: cycle period/phase from rising crossings of Vin/2 on V(sw) over the saved tail; averaged: commanded 2 MHz
method.averaged_prediction: design/averaged/records/ hold loop-gain metrics only (fc, PM, GM); no deviation/recovery prediction exists there. It is derived here by a transient run of design/averaged/buck_avg.spice, unchanged, with the same 0.4 A step pair added at the output (avg_step.spice); the averaged model has no process/T axes
method.tolerance_coverage: C-typ (typical, 27 C, 5.0 V) x all 18 tolerance combinations (request_tol); C-full (45) x the two corners with Ceff 4.7 uF, ESR 10 mohm and L x0.8 / x1.2 (request_full). C-full x the full 18-combination cube (810 units) was NOT run; deviation ~ dI/(2 pi fc Ceff) + dI ESR is worst at 4.7 uF / 10 mohm for any L, but this is an argument, not a run, for the other process/T/Vin corners

R12.what: load-step transient 50 -> 450 -> 50 mA at 1 A/us, switched: deviation <= 0.09 V and recovery to +-0.018 V within 2.5e-05 s, each step graded only after the 0.4 settled test; >= 100 cycles after each step

R13b.what: R13(b): the switched step per P-T tolerance corner (same grading as R12)

R13c.what: R13(c): switched step vs averaged-model step, peak deviation and recovery time of both edges, +-30 %
